column1: # The opening demo's footage (tools/encode-hero.sh). Columns are TAB-separated:

column5: The stream as chat sees it, before anyone pays.
The streamer turns to oxidised copper, crown and all, and keeps talking.
The whole room is redrawn as a hand-drawn anime, sunset in the window.
Something pale climbs up behind the chair and holds on.
Flames on the streamer's head, lit and moving with every turn.
Green slime pours out with every word.
Wrapped head to toe in bandages, headphones still on.
One detail changed: a sharp platinum bob, everything else untouched.
A polar bear takes the chair, scarf, headphones and a cold drink.
